packageRules.description: Group non-major npm updates into one PR per repo per run instead of one PR per package. Non-major already automerges on green CI below, so this only changes how many times the full CI gate reruns for routine bumps, not the review/merge behaviour. Comes before the dev-tooling/pnpm rules below so those more specific groups still win (later packageRules override earlier ones).
Group non-major Go module updates into one PR per repo per run, same rationale as npm-non-major.
Group non-major GitHub Actions digest/version updates into one PR per repo per run, same rationale as npm-non-major.
Group the shared toolchain so each repo gets one dev-tooling PR
Surface Corepack pnpm pin bumps (packageManager field) on their own

Hold the fleet on the Node 24 major: @types/node and the node pin track it, not the latest (Node 25 is not LTS). Repos on an older Node (e.g. rc-hubspot on 20) set a tighter cap in their own renovate.json, which takes precedence.

Automerge non-major updates once CI is green. Majors stay manual for a human look. lockFileMaintenance is deliberately excluded (its updateType is not listed) because CI builds the @kc/* file: siblings from their own main, not the local branch, so a lockfile regenerated wrongly can pass CI undetected — those land manually.
